data.description:
## Testing Mode
GREEN

## Story DD Coverage
This task is responsible for satisfying the following story done definitions:
- dd-1: SKILL.md emits EMIT-PRECONDITIONS and gates on 4 named preconditions: (1) project_type=web, (2) playwright_available, (3) check-local-env.sh exit 0, (4) route_map_fresh<24h
- dd-2: Precondition failure writes visual_eval_inapplicable:<reason> to ticket AND integration gate — not silent soft-pass
- dd-3: route-map.json sourced from .ui-discovery-cache/route-map.json; absent → visual_eval_inapplicable:route_map_missing
- dd-4: Screenshot capture at routes, design-manifest synthesis from .claude/design-notes.md + metadata; Figma graceful-degrade

## Implementation Notes
Create plugins/dso/skills/visual-evaluator/SKILL.md. Must include:

1. EMIT-PRECONDITIONS landmark (required by check-precondition-emit.sh hook)
2. Four gates (checked in order):
   - project_type=web (read from dso-config.conf)
   - playwright_available (command -v npx && npx playwright --version)
   - check-local-env.sh exit 0
   - route_map_fresh<24h (stat .ui-discovery-cache/route-map.json mtime vs now())
3. Five named inapplicability reason codes (use these exact strings):
   - visual_eval_inapplicable:not_web_project
   - visual_eval_inapplicable:playwright_unavailable
   - visual_eval_inapplicable:local_env_check_failed
   - visual_eval_inapplicable:route_map_missing
   - visual_eval_inapplicable:route_map_stale
4. Emission: on any failure, write via `.claude/scripts/dso ticket tag <id> visual_eval_inapplicable:<reason>` AND surface to integration gate via explicit annotation (not soft-pass)
5. Route loading from .ui-discovery-cache/route-map.json; absent case → route_map_missing
6. 24h staleness window documented; route_map_stale MUST be surfaced prominently (not buried in logs)
7. Screenshot capture + design-manifest synthesis section; Figma graceful-degrade annotates with figma:unavailable

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Unit tests pass (exit 0)
  Verify: python3 -m pytest tests/
- [ ] Lint passes (exit 0)
  Verify: ruff check plugins/dso/scripts/*.py tests/**/*.py
- [ ] Format check passes (exit 0)
  Verify: ruff format --check plugins/dso/scripts/*.py tests/**/*.py
- [ ] SKILL.md exists with EMIT-PRECONDITIONS landmark
  Verify: test -f plugins/dso/skills/visual-evaluator/SKILL.md && grep -q 'EMIT-PRECONDITIONS' plugins/dso/skills/visual-evaluator/SKILL.md
- [ ] All 4 named preconditions documented
  Verify: grep -q 'project_type=web' plugins/dso/skills/visual-evaluator/SKILL.md && grep -q 'playwright_available' plugins/dso/skills/visual-evaluator/SKILL.md && grep -q 'check-local-env.sh' plugins/dso/skills/visual-evaluator/SKILL.md && grep -q 'route_map_fresh' plugins/dso/skills/visual-evaluator/SKILL.md
- [ ] All 5 reason codes present with exact strings
  Verify: for r in not_web_project playwright_unavailable local_env_check_failed route_map_missing route_map_stale; do grep -q "visual_eval_inapplicable:$r" plugins/dso/skills/visual-evaluator/SKILL.md || exit 1; done
- [ ] check-precondition-emit.sh passes for the new skill
  Verify: bash plugins/dso/hooks/check-precondition-emit.sh plugins/dso/skills/visual-evaluator/SKILL.md

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus
On 3 consecutive opus failures: escalate to user
data.title: Create visual-evaluator SKILL.md with 4 precondition gates and inapplicability emission
